newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-BULGARIA BEAT CYPRUS 4-1 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BULGARIA BEAT CYPRUS 4-1 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Striker Emil Kostadinov scored twice to help Bulgaria to a decisive 4-1 win over Cyprus in their World Cup qualifier on Wednesday.
Daniel Borimirov opened the scoring in the second minute, blasting the ball past helpless Cyprus goalkeeper Andreas Petrides from eight metres.

Kostadinov, scorer of the decisive goal against France which qualified Bulgaria for the 1994 World Cup finals, put his side in complete command with his two goals before half time, to the delight of the 30,000 crowd who turned out despite the rain and cold.
Cyprus hit back through Ioannios Okkas in the 61st minute
